slots.purpose: Hero: signals 'legal wedding in Italy' at a glance; an Italian civic setting rather than a generic villa, so the image matches a legal guide.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2, min 2000 px. A couple (identifiable, consent on file) walking down the stone steps of a historic palazzo comunale (town hall) onto a sunlit piazza in a Tuscan or Umbrian hill town, just after a civil ceremony. Late spring or early autumn, soft morning light, light editorial grading, uncluttered square, tricolour flag visible on the facade. Town and comune must be named by the photographer or EXIF. Owned library or commissioned photography only; not AI.

slots.purpose: Visualises the two documents (Atto Notorio and Nulla Osta) and the paperwork theme without implying a specific official form.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape or 4:3, min 1400 px. Overhead flat-lay on linen: a plain folder of documents with an apostille-style ribbon seal, a fountain pen, two wedding rings, a passport shape with no legible country, number or crest, a small sprig of olive. No real form text, no Australian or Italian government crests, no personal data. Neutral, light palette. Eligible for an owned photo shoot, or an AI (Higgsfield) flat-lay labelled 'Illustrative image' because it depicts no real place, person or wedding. Not generated this run.

slots.purpose: Shows the in-Italy steps ending in the civil ceremony: the officiant, the interpreter and the setting couples actually marry in.

Natural window light, guests soft in background. Real wedding with couple consent and named comune; credit the photographer. Not AI.
